fields.finding: CR III 5056 has distinct directional shear limits, compression peaks and crush plateau. Datasheet scalars do not identify postpeak curves, densification strains, unloading, mixed-mode interactions or shear rupture energy.
fields.consequence: A candidate directional law is stated in HONEYCOMB-TRANSFER.md, but no calibrated P2 gamma can be released.

claim: CR III 5056 has distinct directional shear limits, compression peaks and crush plateau. Datasheet scalars do not identify postpeak curves, densification strains, unloading, mixed-mode interactions or shear rupture energy.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
